programmes.d: From Don Cheadle to Lou Diamond Phillips to Playmate of the Year Brande Roderick to Meatloaf to Mickey Rooney -- the stars all showed up for the opportunity to play with the greatest poker players of all time at the WPT Invitational.
Players are on board a luxury cruise in the Caribbean and playing for hundreds of thousands of dollars.
The biggest little city in the world plays host to the World Poker Challenge at the Reno Hilton and the last chance to win a guaranteed seat in the WPT Championship.
The World Poker Tour travels across the globe to crown new champions.
On this special edition episode Lou Diamond Phillips joins the WPT for a poker crash course.
In a special, invitation-only event at the Bicycle Casino in Los Angeles, six of the hottest women in poker battle it out in the World Poker Tour arena.
It's a legendary final in Hollywood as six of poker's best line up in Los Angeles for a shot at the 1,500,000-prize pool and one of poker's most prestigious titles.
The stars are out in Hollywood for the WPT Hollywood Home Game.

America's playground swings as the World Poker Tour rolls into Atlantic City for the Borgata Poker Open. Down on the felt it's youth versus experience, novice versus pro, as six WPT hopefuls set their sights on the title and over a million in cash.
In the woods of Connecticut there's a mountain of money at stake as the world's largest casino pays out the biggest WPT prize pool yet.

In one of the most eagerly anticipated finals of the year, the charismatic champion "Gambling" Gus Hansen returns to the final table at the Bellagio Five Diamond Poker Classic to defend his title and stake a claim to the $3,000,000 prize pool.

The World Poker Tour sets down in the enchanting City of Lights for an international poker mêlée, French-style, as six world-class players from four continents battle for pride, country, and over a million in cash.
WPT returns with another installment of the WPT Hollywood Celebrity Home Game.
The Great American Card Game steams up the Mississippi as the World Poker Tour makes land for the Jack Binion World Poker Open.
It's poker heaven in the City of Angels when the Commerce Casino serves up a nearly $4,000,000 prize pool in this L.A. Poker Classic.
